name: bug
description: The integration does something it should not, or not something it should

name: enhancement
description: Something the integration could do for a console that it does not yet

name: playguard
description: Needs a change on the console's side first (JigSawFr/PlayGuard)

name: i18n
description: A translation, or a string that needs one

name: documentation
description: README, CONTRIBUTING or another Markdown file

name: dependencies
description: A pinned action or the test harness moves (Dependabot)

name: good first issue
description: Small and self-contained: a good way into the code

name: help wanted
description: Open to anyone who wants to take it: say so in the issue first

name: duplicate
description: Already reported: the other issue is linked

name: wontfix
description: Out of the integration's scope, or not worth what it costs
